title: LEE3D profile
description:
The single artefact that flows between the three repos: the studio writes it, the exact backend builds from it, and this library stores it.

WHY EVERY KEY CARRIES `x-read-by`. Four bugs in one month were all the same shape — one end knowing about a key the other did not. Pockets were dropped from every STEP export; extra views were ignored without a word; per-face wall thickness was honoured by one builder and not the other, then not by the backend either. None raised an error. This field makes that class of bug visible in the contract itself: if a key says [studio, exact] and only one of them reads it, that is the bug, written down.

`additionalProperties` is deliberately true. A saved model must never fail to load because it carries something this file has not been taught yet — but anything the engine actually depends on belongs here.

adaptiveWall.description: RETIRED. Honoured so older files load unchanged, off otherwise: measured across ten geometries it never once produced a clean win.

bottomPoly.description: Underside silhouette. Material exists only where every view agrees. null = not traced.

bottomProfile.description: Underside height along the length. null = a flat floor.

carveMode.description: Which engine cuts the details. 'field' carves them into the distance field so the wall under a pocket survives; 'stamp' presses them onto the meshed surface, which is faster but halves the wall beneath. Absent means field for a new model, stamp for an older file.

category.description: Folder it is filed under in the library.

closedBottom.description: Seal the underside. False leaves it open, which a toy frame usually wants.

extraViews.description: Silhouettes from ARBITRARY directions — the groundwork for building from photographs. Each removes material like the three axis views do. The exact build cannot use these and reports how many it had to ignore, because a model using them comes out FATTER there.

from.description: Camera position. Present = perspective, and `poly` is then in normalised image coordinates rather than millimetres.

features.description: Carved details. Depth is negative for a pocket, positive for a raise. `through` cuts all the way. A feature with NO depth is a mask or label and has no solid meaning.

view.description: Which face it was drawn on. Decides which way it goes in, and for a finite-depth pocket, where the floor lands.

fieldHollow.description: Hollow by carving the distance field rather than pushing the mesh inward. Default true, and the reason a thin section does not weld into a plank.

frontHull.description: Front-end outline, when the nose is traced separately.

frontPoly.description: Front silhouette, 0..1 of width by 0..1 of height. Material exists only where every view agrees. null = not traced.

hgtMM.description: Height override in mm, 0 = derive from topProfile.

hullCrisp.description: 0 = the smooth rounded body, 1 = exactly the traced outline. Follow my drawing only.

hullFast.description: Set only during a drag, for a provisional build. Never saved deliberately.

hullHollow.description: Build it as a shell rather than a solid lump.

hullQuality.description: Build quality. Scales BOTH the resolution request and its cap — scaling only the cap does nothing on most models.

hullRes.description: Explicit carve grid resolution. Normally derived from stations; capped in the app.

length.description: Nose to tail in mm. The dimension everything else scales from.

mode.description: Which builder runs. 'projection' is Follow my drawing (carves the intersection of the traced outlines); 'loft' is Smooth (lofts sections).

modelScale.description: The denominator of the scale the model is built at: 200 means 1:200. Optional; absent or 1 means the model IS the real size, which is how every car profile behaves.

noDetail.description: Build the plain body and skip every feature.

notchFaceOnly.description: A notch cuts from its own face only, never through.

openArches.description: Open the wheel arches. Older name for openUnderside; both are written so older files still load.

openUnderside.description: Open the underside under the arches.

realLength.description: How long the real thing is, in mm. A 24m building is 24000. Optional, and purely a record: `length` remains the model size that all geometry is built from, so a profile without this behaves exactly as before.

revLen.description: Revolve length in mm. Revolve mode only; the exact build does not claim to build these.

revProfile.description: Revolve outline. Revolve mode only; the exact build does not claim to build these.

revShape.description: Revolve profile family. Revolve mode only; the exact build does not claim to build these.

revSize.description: Revolve size in mm. Revolve mode only; the exact build does not claim to build these.

roofFlatness.description: How square the roof sits over the sections. Smooth only.

schema.description: Schema version this profile was written against.

sculptStrokes.description: The strokes that produced the sculpt, kept so it can be re-applied.

section.description: Cross-section shape for the loft builder.

sections.description: Named cross-sections at positions along the length.

sepBottom.description: Export the floor as a separate piece.

shape.description: Section family for the loft builder.

sidePoly.description: Side silhouette (left flank), in 0..1 of length by 0..1 of height. Material exists only where every view agrees. null = not traced.

sidePolyR.description: Right flank, when it differs from the left. Absent means symmetric. Material exists only where every view agrees. null = not traced.

stations.description: Sections along the length. Also sets the default grid resolution for the carve.

topPoly.description: Plan silhouette, 0..1 of length by 0..1 of width. Material exists only where every view agrees. null = not traced.

topProfile.description: Height along the length, as [fraction, mm] pairs.

trace.description: Reference images and their placement. Not geometry.

units.description: Always mm. Present for readers that cannot assume.

wallPerFace.description: Use the three values below instead of one wall.

wallThickness.description: Wall in mm, when every face is the same.

wallTop.description: Roof thickness in mm. This is the load-bearing control — a thick floor to bolt through with thin walls elsewhere.

widMM.description: Width override in mm, 0 = derive from widthProfile.

widthBottomProfile.description: Half width at the floor, where it differs from the widest point. null = same as widthProfile.

widthProfile.description: HALF width along the length, as [fraction, mm]. Half, not full — the body is mirrored about its centreline.
